_README: Label id -> structure for the Visible Human FEMALE right forearm muscle volume (vhf_forearm_muscles_from_cryo.py). A KEY, not data. rule-based: see the script docstring for the rule; compartments are muscles the photographs do not separate (mapped to null).

Q100 (vhf_split_ecrl_ecrb.py): label 10 (extensor_carpi_radialis_compartment) split into 10 (extensor_carpi_radialis_longus) and 21 (extensor_carpi_radialis_brevis) by a position-rule, not a traced septum; the compartment name no longer appears as a label.
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), female cryosections at full resolution (0.33 mm) and CT via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. Derived data (scripts/cryo/vhf_forearm_muscles_from_cryo.py), rule-based.
